# ts-fsrs

`ts-fsrs.js` is the unmodified UMD build of ts-fsrs 5.4.2, MIT licensed (see
`ts-fsrs.LICENSE`). Source: https://github.com/open-spaced-repetition/ts-fsrs.
Official npm tarball: https://registry.npmjs.org/ts-fsrs/-/ts-fsrs-5.4.2.tgz.
Tarball SHA-1: `7bd23da3d8a35368b813f4064eabe829a46f9901`.
The browser loads this local artifact; no CDN, installation or runtime download.
Scheduling uses `fsrs({request_retention,enable_fuzz:false}).next(card,date,Rating)`.
